item.title: Lake Tazawa: Japan's Deepest Cobalt Lake — Akita Guide
item.description: Lake Tazawa is Japan’s deepest lake at 423 metres, glowing a vivid cobalt blue year-round and never freezing in winter. The golden statue of Tatsuko — a legendary beauty said to have become the lake’s goddess — stands on the western shore, and the surrounding caldera offers panoramic hiking and scenic lakeside drives. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Tazawako, Senboku, Akita Hours Lakeside always open Admission Free Time needed 1.
